title: Sue Keyakinan Nyang Teusöm .
intro: Lam até saboh istana tirani, dipat keukafiran nakeuh huköm nanggroë, saboh jiwa njang sidroë-droë djidjak deungon taloë njang keutat deungon iman dan teumakôt. Individu nyoe, nyang toe ngon pusat kekuasaan, geudeungoe watee peusan sidroe nabi geusambot ngon hinaan dan ancaman. Siat keubeunaran teuka, meupaksa ureueng nyoe geupiléh antara aman seungap ngon geupeugah haba keubeunaran nyang bahaya. Jeut neubuka identitas pendukung nyang gagah nyoe?
clues: Lon tinggai lam rumoh tangga sidroe tiran, lon saksikan keudroe keusombongan nyang jitulak tanda-tanda ilahi.
Iman ulôn ulôn peurahsia, sibagoe hareuta nyang teusöm lam meuligoe teumpat seumah beurala.
Lon deungoe peumimpén nyang lon layani meukomplot keuneuk poh sidroe rasul Allah, sidroe ureueng nyang nan jih Musa.
Lon peugah bak logika awaknyan, lon peuingat awaknyan keuhai nasib umat Nuh, ‘Ad, dan Thamud.

Lon peugot saboh pertanyaan kritis keu umat lon: ‘Meunyoe gobnyan sidroe ureueng peugah haba sulet, sulet gobnyan na ateueh gobnyan; teuma meunyoe Gobnyan beutôi, na padum-padum boh janji Gobnyan teuma jipoh gata.'
Kisah lon peugah sibagoe teuladan iman lam surah nyang nan jih ‘The Forgiver,’ disinan lon peuingat umat lon teuntang rancana-rancana ureueng nyang meukuasa.

trial.answer: Membela Nabi Musa SAW di pengadilan zalim

location.label: Peue Tema Argumen Lon?
options: Tuntutan tanda nibak bak kayee suci .
Penciptaan aneuk leumo dari perhiasan cair .

outcome.label: Peue Hase jih?
options: Allah geupeuseulamat individu nyoe nibak rancana brok awaknyan .
Tiran nyan meutobat bak saat tenggelam .
Individu nyan geu-asingkan u nanggroe nyang jioh .
outcome.answer: Allah geupeuseulamat individu nyoe nibak rancana brok awaknyan .

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
